name: Festival
source: testdata/eval/ground-truth.json V14 (the miss list), which is also what the shipped judge lines read out of testdata/clef/judge-V14-festival.json; the biggest issue is that recording's own choice. The pick is the fix of the recorded issue. The runner-up is the fix of the lowest-read flagged criterion the pick does not address and that some fix on the menu addresses: festival-necklace at 0.0304, whose fix is festival-gold-chain; the same rule gives date-tie-hair for V03 and funeral-short-beard for V18. Both passes are discards, and the story shows no render: no render check of the festival occasion was ever recorded, and a render is shown only when a recorded check of it passes the change and the person, so nothing here can be shown. Its runner-up picture is the genuine recorded necklace try-on of this selfie (testdata/youcam/necklace-fetch.json saved testdata/youcam/results/necklace-chain-V14.jpg, and testdata/youcam/necklace-upload-src.json uploaded woman/V14-festival.jpg to make it); it is named as evidence that the pass ran and what it made, and nothing more - no check of it exists, so no frame carries it, it is registered in no mediastore and it reaches no screen. The story holds no cached reading: the one recorded face-attr read is of woman/V06-family-function.jpg (testdata/youcam/face-attr-upload-src.json, answered Oval by testdata/youcam/http-face-attr-poll.json), and the analysis cache is keyed by photo hash, so a reading of V06 is not a reading of V14; a sample never measures, so festival's hair pass names no analysis and its measure stage says skipped. A discarded pass carries no check values, because none was recorded for it.
